options.name: alias
options.description: Boolean specifying if the id is an alias

options.name: alias_order
options.description: The order in which alias volume IDs are assigned.

options.name: capacity
options.description: The size of the volume. Required when I(state=present)

options.name: capacity_type
options.description: The units of measurement of the size of the volume.

options.name: ckd_base_ids
options.description: List of existing base CKD volume IDs to create aliases for.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the DS8000 storage system HMC.

options.name: id
options.description: The volume IDs of the DS8000 volume to work with. Required when I(state=absent) Only one element is allowed when I(alias=yes)

options.name: lss
options.description: The logical subsystem (lss) that the volume will be created on.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the DS8000 volume to work with. Required when I(state=present)

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the DS8000 storage system I(username).

options.name: pool
options.description: The pool id that the volume will be created on. Required when I(state=present)

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the DS8000 storage system HMC.

options.name: quantity
options.description: The number of volumes that will be created.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify the state the DS8000 volume should be in.

options.name: storage_allocation_method
options.description: Choose the storage allocation method that the DS8000 will use in creating your volume. Valid value is C(none), extent space-efficient C(ese), track space-efficient C(tse).

options.name: username
options.description: The username for the DS8000 storage system.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Controls validation of SSL chain of trust. Set to C(no) to allow connection when SSL certificates are not trusted.

options.name: volume_type
options.description: The volume type that will be created. Valid value is fixed block C(fb) or count key data C(ckd).
